mechanism.claim: When a completed BTC day exhibits unusually high contemporaneous price impact per unit of normalized aggressive flow, market-maker inventory capacity is scarce. In an already high-variation regime, the current impact channel can dominate delayed information and the completed aggregate flow should reverse over the next twelve hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of completed-day aggregate aggressive quote flow

external_basis.paper: Heterogeneous Return Predictability from Order Flow
external_basis.author: Meichen Qian
external_basis.reported_result: order-flow return predictability can become negative when market makers are very unwilling to provide liquidity, with high volatility strengthening the reversal
external_basis.adaptation: positive through-origin hourly flow-impact beta is used only as a transparent daily inventory-capacity proxy; no coefficient or threshold is fitted to BTC outcomes

mechanism.why_distinct: HVFIC compares high- versus low-flow bars inside offset eight-hour blocks and follows same-sign flow. HVLIR follows hourly price displacement after turnover-normalized impact. HVPST estimates next-bar signed-turnover reversal gamma and fades price. HVDFICR instead uses one full UTC day of 24 hourly normalized-flow/return pairs, ranks the single positive contemporaneous impact beta as a market-maker capacity state, and fades aggregate flow. It reuses no prior event set or diagnostic control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed daily realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most one sparse 00:05 UTC capacity-tail onset per day is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact 00:00 UTC day boundary D
features.source_day: 1,440 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual one-minute rows [D-24h,D), partitioned into 24 exact nonoverlapping hourly buckets
features.hour_return: log(hour last close/hour first open), finite strict nonzero
features.hour_normalized_flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume), with positive denominator and finite strict nonzero value
features.impact_beta: sum(hour_normalized_flow*hour_return)/sum(hour_normalized_flow^2) through the origin over all 24 hours; finite strict positive
features.aggregate_flow: sum daily signed aggressive quote divided by sum daily quote turnover; finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute open-to-close log returns) over the completed day; finite strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of impact beta and realized variation over at most 180 earlier source-valid days, minimum 120, current excluded
features.onset: full eligible state true now and false on the immediately preceding exact source-valid day; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.feature_available: D after the completed UTC source day
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: q90 only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp and 10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-predicted order-flow reversal under scarce market-maker capacity

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, hourly partition, beta, rank, variation, onset, side, delay, hold, clock, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
